name: Argentina Game Show
blurb: Latin America's largest video-game expo, combining esports, streaming and live music in Buenos Aires.
notes: Official site shows no dates at all, only a repeating '#AGS2026 ¡MUY PRONTO!' (coming soon) banner and the description 'AGS VISA 2026 es la edicion numero 12' - no day/month given, so no edition is listed for the window. A web search indicates AGS had planned Dec 10-12, 2026 at Costa Salguero but postponed it, with organizers now saying the show returns in April 2027 (per a Facebook announcement reported by titulares.ar, which I could not load directly - 403); that single secondhand mention isn't firm enough to record as a dated edition, so it's left out rather than guessed. 'last' uses the most recent edition I could confirm actually happened (Oct 11-13, 2025, Costa Salguero, Buenos Aires), per search results (exact day span moderately confident, year/month corroborated by multiple sources). Organizer confirmed on-site: footer text 'Es una producción de AGS Producciones Group' and a footer logo alt 'AGS Producciones Group'.
